name: Barron Hill Blueberries
tagline: Link to Barron Hill Blueberries Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Barron
description: In 524 Barron Hill Road, NC, Barron Hill Blueberries raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Check the website for current hours and availability.
